rows.name: Repair
rows.label: patch the well lining (2 fire clay)

lines: CURRENT STATE
A split in the fired lining lets the drawn water
drain through the rim. Pack the gap with fire clay.
Repair: 2 fire clay. Composition: Masonry.
Fire clay seals this well's fired lining. A sound
lining allows drinking and vessel filling;
repairing a split takes two measures of fire clay.
The old supply cellar in the western ruin stored
repair clay. The reed basin nearby holds only a few
drinks; it cannot refill this well.
Type: Object
Composition: Masonry
